title: Freya and the Compass
author: Yara Whitlock
blurb: Lior Dunmore, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
